Recover delayed hand motion at native resolution.
Recover the hair flare and settling states, poorly served by sparse stills.
Recover lower-body shading detail omitted by the Compact pixel budget.
Recover tag and frame reordering so early 10-12 frame counts are not mistaken for the final count.
